item.title: Handwiring my own Ortholinear Keyboard
item.description:
Was looking at making my own keyboard for a long time, but after getting a 3d-printer I decided to try.

From Printables I have found a 3d-print file for an compact ortholinear keyboard I wanted to build A⋅TE⋅B1 Ortholinear Keyboard so I printed it on my 3d printer Creality Ender 3 Max with Black PLA 1.75mm filament.

Parts I used

  • 3d printed case
  • Electric wire - Sparkfun Hook-Up Wire Kit
  • USB-C Arduino Pro Micro (ATmega32U4) from Aliexpress
  • 59 Keychron Z114 Gateron Phantom Switch - Yellow
  • 59 1N4148 diodes
  • Glorious Aura Keycaps v2 - Pixel Pink

Parts not used

  • 2 Stabilisers
  • 4 M2 screw inserts + 4 M2x8mm screws

Tools

  • 3d printer (Creality Ender 3 Max) + Black PLA 1.75mm Filament
  • Soldering iron PINECIL V2 + lead free solder + Helping hands + Blue soldering mat
  • Wire stripper + Wire cutter
  • Tweezers from iFixit Pro Tech Toolkit

Assembly

After putting in all the key switches, I bended, cut, and soldered diodes on the key switches then to each other (row).

item.title: I daily drove an linux phone (Oneplus 6T)
item.description:
Introduction

I got an second hand Oneplus 6T 128GB 8GB

It came quite a bit dirty, lot’s of dents around the frame of the phone and a huge dent on the charging port, extremely scratched screen, but the back glass was prestine probably replaced.

Which originally came out in 2018 which is old by today standards but still very ususable and faster than some newer mid-low range smartphones, installing LineageOS makes it a very capable phone in 2025.

item.title: Daily driving an iPhone 5s in 2025
item.description:
Info

The iPhone 5s came out all the way back on September 20, 2013 it is almost 12 years old

Software

Shipping originally with IOS 7

IOS 12 was released to the public on September 17, 2018, the latest IOS supported is now IOS 12.5.7 a security update which came out on January 23, 2023.

Apple has a great track record of long term software support for their iPhone, which might make using old iPhone’s easier than android. As android at the time only came with 1-2 years of software update plus 1 more year of security update.

item.title: Setting up a server
item.description:
About

This is just a simple guide on how I setup basic software on a server.

Prerequisites

I would pick debian as it is most supported.

Download and flash correct architecture iso to flash drive or copy to Ventoy drive or as I do netboot.xyz on ventoy, easily booting into diffrent up to date operating systems using iPXE (internet required).

Plug in flash drive and you would probably need to connect display, keyboard and/or mouse (depeding cli or gui install) to the server.
